en: Black‑and‑white view down a tree‑lined, unpaved street in a small European town. On the left stands a two‑storey building with the word "Gasthof" painted on its wall, indicating an inn or guesthouse. To the right are substantial masonry houses with fenced front gardens. In the middle distance a horse‑drawn carriage and a few people are visible in front of more buildings with arched windows. The style and vehicles suggest an early 20th‑century scene.
